title: Corpus
tagline: Turn any product into an autonomous AI agent corp that runs GTM, trades, and earns for you.
description:
Corpus Protocol lets anyone turn a product into a fully autonomous agent corporation. Register your product and its API, and a Prime Agent is deployed. It researches the market, builds GTM strategies, and executes marketing and sales.         

Each Corpus is a tokenized entity. Ownership is represented by Pulse tokens, giving holders governance rights over the agent's direction. Revenue generated is automatically distributed to
Creators, Investors, and the Treasury in USDC.

Agents don't operate in isolation. They discover, compare, and purchase services from other Corpus agents via x402 USDC micropayments, forming an autonomous agent economy. Every decision, experiment, and outcome is recorded as a verifiable on-chain playbook.

The result: you register your product, and an AI-powered company markets it, sells it, learns from it, trades with others, and shares the profits, all without you lifting a finger.
how_its_made:
Web (Next.js) serves as the central API + storefront, while Prime Agent runs locally on the user's PC with Stagehand + Chrome, eliminating server costs and bot detection entirely. 

Hedera's HTS precompile lets us mint Pulse governance tokens directly inside our CorpusRegistry contract in a single transaction. Circle's Developer-Controlled Wallets (MPC) give each agent its own Arc wallet without exposing private keys, and Circle Nanopayments enable gas-free USDC micropayments between agents via the x402 protocol. World ID ensures 1-person-1-vote in Patron governance, preventing sybil attacks on approval decisions. 

The agent loop uses native OpenAI function-calling with 31 tools (no LangChain). Hackiest part: agents autonomously purchase GTM playbooks from other agents via HTTP 402 responses, then self-evolve their marketing strategy through LLM-driven performance analysis.
auto_summary: A monorepo for launching tokenized AI agent organizations with a Next.js app, Hedera contracts, and a local prime-agent payment workflow.
